summary: Fight power. Graves' real damage is the gun (35 DPS base) plus her summons; Grasping Hands is 90 damage at x1.6 spirit power and the ultimate x1.27, so spirit power matters but is not everything. Essence Theft T2 (steals 45% weapon damage) is the first big fight spike, Hands T2/T3 the next. Items multiply both halves: spirit power and cooldowns for Hands/ult/deadheads, fire rate and weapon damage for the gun, Spellslinger and Recharging Rush to tie them together. Survivability: about 1200 health and 1500 spirit effective health, lifesteal from Spiritual Overflow, no escape; the ghouls and deadheads are the decoys.

spikes.text: Essence Theft T2: 45% weapon damage stolen from the target - first big fight spike.
Grasping Hands T2: damage doubles; Improved Spirit and Enchanter's Emblem are already in.
Rapid Recharge: +2 Jar of Dead charges and spirit power on charged abilities.
Grasping Hands T3: 20s cooldown and 2 ghouls; the imbued Ballistic Enchantment buff is up far more often.
